description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_LanguageFactory class responsible for creating and managing language objects, including caching, fallbacks, and language loading logic within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_LanguageFactory
classes.description: Factory class for generating and managing HTMLPurifier_Language objects, with caching and fallback handling.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Retrieves or resets the singleton instance of the factory.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the singleton, setting up validator and directory path.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a language object, handling class fallback logic.

methods.name: getFallbackFor
methods.description: Returns the fallback language code for a given language.

methods.name: loadLanguage
methods.description: Loads language data into cache, including message files and fallback merging.
